name: End Sleep
source:
Kazuki has lived an unlucky life. His parents passed away when he was young and his relationship with his adoptive parents did not last long. Now an university student, he took up a high-paying live-in part-time job in a mansion deep in the mountains despite being suspicious about it.

When he got there, he met a beautiful girl who wondered if he would become her older brother. Not knowing what she meant by this, he chased after her into the mansion where many other people had gathered, all but one of whom were around his age. Their task was explained to them there: to live there while playing their assigned role. As foreseen by the girl from earlier, Sui, he was given the 'older brother' role, while she was the 'imouto'.

This strange life began without any problems, until one rainy night when the sound of glass breaking echoed through the mansion. They hurried towards the sound and found one of their own had been brutally murdered.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一树过着不幸的生活。他年幼时父母去世，与养父母的关系也没有维持多久。如今作为一名大学生，他尽管心存疑虑，还是接受了一份深山宅邸中的高薪包住兼职。到达那里后，他遇到了一个美丽的女孩，她问他是否愿意做她的哥哥。不明白她什么意思的他追着她进入了宅邸，里面已经聚集了许多其他人，除了一位以外都和他年纪相仿。他们的任务在那里被说明：住在里面并扮演被分配的角色。正如那个叫翠的女孩所预料的那样，他被分配了“哥哥”的角色，而她则是“妹妹”。这种奇怪的生活顺利地开始了，直到一个雨夜，玻璃破碎的声音回荡在宅邸中。他们急忙循声而去，发现他们中的一员已被残忍杀害。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
